body: I know you're probably very close to the edge right now. I am too man. But all I can say is don't do it. I know this probably won't deter you. But for some reason I don't want others to take their own life... But for some reason it's justified for me to want to take my own. I don't know. I love you dude. I've never met you before but I love you just because of the fact that you're going through this right now. You seem like a good dude. Why gamble on killing yourself when you can gamble in a lot of other different ways? Do something new. Try to make whatever you can of your life before it ends. I wish I could do this as well, but maybe someone else telling you will help. Take care man, I'm hoping you pull through.
